source.inventory: Exact retained source; English read-only Phase 1 scope inventory.

clauses.phase1Duty: Native visibility and offline trace/statistics presentation without changing authoritative runtime state.
clauses.exclusions: Custom dashboards and distributed tracking.
clauses.conditions: PRD distinguishes Data Foundation custody from derived visibility; architecture owns exact persistence mechanism.

clauses.phase1Duty: Show live native /swarmflows run-tree progress, blockers, gate verdicts, budgets and component health through CLI/native Web.
clauses.exclusions: Custom persistent dashboards, bespoke workflow visualizers and aggregate multi-run UIs.
clauses.conditions: Visibility remains a projection and cannot write gate or run authority.

clauses.phase1Duty: Expose append-only records.jsonl, isolated Run Bundles and static capsule-version Markdown/JSON scorecards with failures and undeclared-tool observations.
clauses.exclusions: Interactive cross-run search engine or Elasticsearch/Kibana integration.
clauses.conditions: Keep exact trace ordering and custody; offline scorecard summaries do not independently establish acceptance.

clauses.phase1Duty: Measure and persist actual duration and model/tool invocation counts, frozen limits, and reliable available usage/cost telemetry.
clauses.exclusions: Cross-user chargebacks, dynamic cluster capacity and cloud billing APIs.
clauses.conditions: Codex usage/cost may be null/unavailable and informational; mechanically observed duration/calls govern budgets.

clauses.phase1Duty: Capture OS, CPU core count and GPU model once at run start.
clauses.exclusions: Continuous CPU/GPU/RAM sampling, live resource dashboards and hardware-driven load balancing.
clauses.conditions: The blacklist applies to continuous monitoring; static one-time hardware facts remain active Phase 1 duty.

clauses.phase1Duty: Python packaging and single-command local initialization/background/status serving.
clauses.exclusions: Standalone compiled desktop shells and automatic updating.
clauses.conditions: Do not infer publication authorization or supported-platform installation from a local wheel build.

clauses.phase1Duty: Supported macOS/Linux pip distribution and jiuwenswarm-start; scaffold input/POC/records directories, seed version-locked capability registry, configure telemetry, doctor actual auth/paths/static-DAG readiness, expose terminal research input.
clauses.exclusions: Auto-updates, backups/restores and setup wizards.
clauses.conditions: RSI task/oracle scaffolding and manually authored fixture provisioning consume separate approved assets and isolation; they do not activate Phase 2 RSI execution. Reconcile distribution naming and architecture amendments explicitly.

clauses.phase1Duty: Automatically serve authenticated loopback native Web/status surface, bind active session/runtime/gates, accept text and display final Markdown delivery.
clauses.exclusions: Cloud-hosted public/LAN or multi-tenant runtime APIs.
clauses.conditions: PRD names 127.0.0.1:5173 and ephemeral auth bootstrap; exact architecture implementation must preserve authentication/privacy. Do not record token values in evidence.

clauses.phase1Duty: Enforce CLI/local Web interaction and exclusion of compiled desktop binaries.
clauses.exclusions: Windows/macOS .exe/.dmg desktop shells, Electron/Tauri, GUI setup and update daemons.
clauses.conditions: This exclusion does not remove supported macOS/Linux CLI installation obligations.

clauses.phase1Duty: Reuse native CLI, Web and TUI with lightweight branding and standard output retrieval.
clauses.exclusions: Bespoke product UI implementations that replace native workflow semantics.
clauses.conditions: Existing native surfaces must reflect protected runtime state.

clauses.phase1Duty: Scriptable research input/status/lifecycle/evidence CLI and explicit non-interactive headless mode with frozen config, requested/effective seed, run_id/bundle reference and stable terminal status.
clauses.exclusions: Replacement interactive shell and deep custom ASCII visualization.
clauses.conditions: Headless never waits for human_session. Unsupported seed control is unavailable; no deterministic model-output claim.

clauses.phase1Duty: Native local Web intake/run-tree/gate/artifact delivery plus static logo/title/theme branding; read final Markdown report.
clauses.exclusions: Custom hypothesis widgets, drag-and-drop workflow builders, cloud user portals, setup wizards, mid-flight modification and changed falsifiability bounds.
clauses.conditions: Intake/output monitor only; user-visible state grants no gate override.

clauses.phase1Duty: Expose native jiuwenswarm-tui and correlated human_session fault/log inspection before explicit abort/correction.
clauses.exclusions: Custom rubric/RSI widgets and distributed hardware heatmaps.
clauses.conditions: Interactive triage never converts a failed gate into PASS; headless executes stable halt semantics without prompting.

clauses.phase1Duty: Preserve durable product identity separately from local execution isolation and bind all research work to active user/workspace/run.
clauses.exclusions: Enterprise account/security products beyond M1 whitelist.
clauses.conditions: Approved account/profile persistence may be cloud-backed; it is not another research execution host. OS identity/token is not the permanent product identity.

clauses.phase1Duty: Stable user/account ID, profile lifetime independent of runs/workspace, local execution binding/preferences and source-grounded run-specific context.
clauses.exclusions: Enterprise directories, organization roles, shared multi-user workspaces and complex profile UI.
clauses.conditions: No cloud account product is required merely because cloud persistence is permitted; exact approved mechanism is architecture-owned. Do not infer scientific context from unrelated history.

clauses.phase1Duty: Strict 127.0.0.1 binding and random locally protected session token in every local API request, with session/security lifecycle.
clauses.exclusions: Enterprise SSO/MFA/OAuth product login flows and multi-tenant network cookies.
clauses.conditions: 600 POSIX custody must be demonstrated on supported environment; Windows source inspection does not prove POSIX permissions or real IPC.

clauses.phase1Duty: Restrict generated POC execution to unprivileged workspace/poc identity; secure native Codex IPC with private UDS/named pipe; boot pre-check protected fixture unreadability.
clauses.exclusions: Open TCP model adapter, heavy Docker/Kubernetes orchestration, hypervisor VMs and eBPF layers.
clauses.conditions: tmux is operational session management, not POC confinement. Fixture Oracle provisioning/pre-check is conditional on approved separate assets; no Phase 2 execution promotion.

clauses.phase1Duty: Authorized local inspection/removal of assets/artifacts/records and clear account-vs-execution data separation with attributable independent profile persistence.
clauses.exclusions: Enterprise retention/legal hold and advanced privacy administration UI.
clauses.conditions: Filesystem controls may satisfy local removal; do not invent mandatory cloud deletion UI. Workspace deletion never falsely claims product account deletion.

clauses.phase1Duty: Keep research intake/control/attention within authorized local Web/CLI/TUI and local terminal management.
clauses.exclusions: External messaging connectors.
clauses.conditions: Approved cloud account storage remains distinguishable from local execution/message channels.

clauses.phase1Duty: Owned local tmux sessions/panes for background DAG/services, attach/detach and live logs/fault inspection.
clauses.exclusions: Remote multi-node terminal synchronization/forwarding.
clauses.conditions: tmux alone does not demonstrate generated-code process isolation.

clauses.phase1Duty: Disable external chat adapters/webhooks/bots; allow direct local CLI/Web prompts and permitted filesystem input only.
clauses.exclusions: WeChat/Discord/Slack/Feishu external research intake and mobile approvals.
clauses.conditions: Do not delete unrelated platform connectors; exclude them from the active product launcher/profile.

clauses.phase1Duty: Resolve validated declarative local configuration and freeze actual effective state at run start.
clauses.exclusions: Remote config syncing and multi-host topology declarations.
clauses.conditions: Architecture owns exact files, precedence and implementation; later config edits cannot mutate active run.

clauses.phase1Duty: Register static Codex baseline endpoint and role aliases without exposing secrets; approved experimental config is isolated.
clauses.exclusions: Dynamic provider rotation, cloud secret managers and runtime key provisioning.
clauses.conditions: Unapproved alternate endpoints must remain mocked/non-executable; experimental config cannot change normal Phase 1 Codex aliases. No Phase 3 routing implementation is promoted.

clauses.phase1Duty: Local workspace/POC paths, hardware/ingestion preferences and strict project-over-global-user precedence.
clauses.exclusions: Organization-wide preference policies, setup wizards and multi-user switching.
clauses.conditions: Supported ingestion defaults are .txt/.md/.pdf; account preferences remain distinct from run-specific scientific requests.

clauses.phase1Duty: Enforce strict per-CC time budgets and mechanically monitored invocation guardrails.
clauses.exclusions: Real-time monetary billing quotas and financial dynamic rerouting.
clauses.conditions: Token enforcement depends on sufficiently reliable call-level telemetry; unsupported usage/cost is unavailable.

clauses.phase1Duty: Restrict execution topology to one authorized local host.
clauses.exclusions: Distributed worker addresses/heartbeats/multi-host concurrency and leases.
clauses.conditions: Cloud-backed account/profile or non-execution product services are not prohibited by this execution-host boundary.

clauses.phase1Duty: Explicit reproducible evaluation profiles, frozen effective components, predeclared controlled ablation and truthful actually executed state.
clauses.exclusions: End-user component customization, arbitrary third-party loading, live production reconfiguration and user gate disabling.
clauses.conditions: Mandatory-control ablation is labelled non-product and cannot satisfy Phase 1 completion or change production standing. Configuring RSI participation does not activate separate Phase 2 execution.

clauses.phase1Duty: Use dependency-ordered Phase 1 fixed 3.1..3.9 engineering sequence.
clauses.exclusions: Replacing required research responsibilities through architecture detail.
clauses.conditions: Product owns outcomes/sequence; architecture owns technical realization.

clauses.phase1Duty: Every stage leaves an actual runnable connected boundary with admitted CC, evidence bundle, gate decision, advance/halt and persisted evidence.
clauses.exclusions: Claiming integrated completion from isolated business logic.
clauses.conditions: Independent preparation may continue while dependent stage acceptance remains incomplete.

clauses.phase1Duty: Separate Phase 2 RSI scope and entry/exit requirements; not current Phase 1 runtime work.
clauses.exclusions: Automatic activation of M0-018 or accepting Phase 2 from Phase 1 fixtures.
clauses.conditions: This is required for the complete M1 release/demo gate under 1.5/6.14, but not promoted by the current Phase 1/TRIAL alignment request.

clauses.phase1Duty: Separate expected Phase 3 efforts and explicit PASS/BLOCKED/INCOMPLETE accounting with preserved deterministic fallback.
clauses.exclusions: Automatic activation of M0-019 or treating current Phase 1/TRIAL as dynamic integration proof.
clauses.conditions: Phase 3 is not automatically M2/Future State; it remains separate from this requested alignment.

clauses.phase1Duty: Preserve PRD product outcomes/scope/invariants/acceptance while architecture defines schemas/APIs/topology/security mechanisms.
clauses.exclusions: Silently changing product behavior to suit implementation constraints.
clauses.conditions: Both views belong to M0; record genuine discrepancies as decisions rather than sole-authority exclusion.

clauses.phase1Duty: Active Phase 1 gaps remain explicit; complete research/gate/fault/evidence/security obligations cannot be inferred from isolated code.
clauses.exclusions: Claiming whole-M1 release/demo from Phase 1+TRIAL or automatically promoting Phase 2/3 execution.
clauses.conditions: Whole M1 release/demo additionally needs Stage 8/Phase 2. Phase 3 must be separately accounted for; Phase 1 completion report is not full-M1 completion.

clauses.phase1Duty: Complete fixed governed research baseline and Stages 0..7; produce Phase_1_Completion_Report.md with coverage, executed tests, failures/blockers, limitations and evidence.
clauses.exclusions: Phase_2_Completion_Report.md and Phase_3_Completion_Report.md are separate duties.
clauses.conditions: The report records actual status; it does not make incomplete stages PASS.

stageExits.criterion: A local process executes a bounded real Codex call through required local security.
Actual worker Node A -> Gate -> worker Node B: valid output releases B, invalid output prevents B, and headless failure durably halts without human_session. The semantic verifier is not work Node B.
Supported request/resources produce a validated Research_Brief.json and initialize the fixed M1 DAG without autonomous planning; intermediate Intent alone is insufficient.
Accepted Brief progresses through grounded Candidate_Set.json, Opportunity_Card.json and immutable Hypothesis_Blueprint.json with constraints/citations/gate evidence.
Accepted immutable hypothesis becomes bounded mechanically valid gate-admitted POC_Artifact_Bundle.zip without autonomous repair.

Actual baseline/treatment protocol and admitted empirical evidence demonstrate scientific positive and correctly executed negative classifications; both reach appropriate downstream state when infrastructure is valid.

One request completes Stage 3.1..3.9 with every governed transition represented and gate-controlled, scientific-negative delivery preserved, final Markdown/artifacts exposed and lifecycle durably closed.
A developer installs, initializes, executes, observes, inspects and retrieves the complete research workflow through supported local workstation interfaces.

gaps.issue: Current intent-only projection does not establish native full-DAG run-tree, offline scorecards or one-time hardware profiling.
Local wheel/native fixture build does not prove supported macOS/Linux installation, requested distribution/start identity, full workstation scaffold/doctor or account-secured packaged execution.
The current minimal Web/headless driver does not establish native TUI/human_session or actual owned POSIX tmux operation.

Account identity/persistence is separate from workspace lifetime; local authorized data removal is active Phase 1 and cannot stay blanket future context. No mandatory cloud account/deletion UI may be invented.
Windows mock/protocol source tests do not establish protected real IPC/600 custody or unprivileged generated POC confinement.
Conditional fixture scaffolding, experimental config and ablation visibility must not promote Phase 2 RSI or Phase 3 dynamic execution, nor imply full-M1 release completion.
The current two-CC Intent trial is not actual work Node B, full Brief/static graph, research path, Builder/POC, scientific execution/evaluation or Delivery.
Phase_1_Completion_Report.md must account for all Stage 0..7 outcomes and remaining gaps; no existing trial PASS can close those product stages.
Scientific FAIL is not infrastructure FAIL: correctly executed admitted negative science must proceed to faithful Delivery without being rewritten into success.
